Glance 2026.09.04 adds interactive panorama video previews.

## Highlights

- Preview Insta360 INSV and DJI OSV videos in 3D with drag-to-look and wheel FOV control.
- Switch between projected playback and synchronized dual 180-degree source views.
- Tune view angle and overlap independently for INSV and OSV with live updates.
